question: What are your clinic hours on Saturday?
golden_answer: On Saturdays, BrightSmile Dental Care is open from 09:30 AM to 08:30 PM IST, split into a Morning Session (09:30 AM – 01:30 PM) and an Evening Session (02:30 PM – 08:30 PM), with a one-hour afternoon sterilization and lunch break from 01:30 PM to 02:30 PM when no routine chairside procedures are scheduled (though the front desk remains staffed).
notes: Weekly schedule table.

question: Is the clinic open on Sundays?
golden_answer: No, BrightSmile Dental Care is closed every Sunday for routine consultations, elective procedures, and walk-in visits. For urgent post-operative complications on Sundays between 10:00 AM and 06:00 PM, existing post-op patients can call the Urgent After-Hours Triage Line at +91-20-5550-0199; for life-threatening or systemic airway emergencies (ESC-01), patients should go directly to Jupiter Hospital Baner or Manipal Hospital Baner or call 112 / 108.
notes: Sunday closure section; after-hours guidance lives in DENT-035. The 'existing post-op patients' detail comes from DENT-035 §5.

question: Where can I park my car when I come for an appointment?
golden_answer: Complimentary four-wheeler (car/SUV) patient parking is available in Basement Level 1 (B1) of Aura Business Plaza at Bays B1-14, B1-15, and B1-16 (collect a visitor token at the ramp boom barrier and validate it at clinic reception). Two-wheeler bays (TW-01 to TW-06) are separate on the ground level. During peak Saturday mornings (10:30 AM – 01:00 PM), if B1-14 to B1-16 are full, overflow paid parking is available along the Baner Road service lane or at the Balewadi High Street multi-level parking complex 400 metres away.
notes: Four-wheeler bays vs two-wheeler bays; don't mix them up.

question: Which days is the orthodontist available?
golden_answer: Senior Consultant Orthodontist Dr. Meera Kulkarni (STF-002) is available on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays (09:30 AM – 01:30 PM and 02:30 PM – 08:30 PM, excluding the 01:30 PM – 02:30 PM sterilization break).
notes: Team roster table.

question: How late can I be before I lose my appointment?
golden_answer: Under Policy POL-LAT-01, there are three late-arrival thresholds: (1) 0 to 15 minutes late (Grace Period): your full appointment proceeds with ₹0 penalty; (2) 16 to 25 minutes late (Moderate Delay): the dentist may perform a shortened diagnostic assessment or shift you to a same-day standby gap if chair time permits (₹0 fee same day, or ₹250 if rescheduled to a future date); and (3) More than 25 minutes late (Late-Arrival Forfeit): you lose your appointment slot and it is treated as a short-notice cancellation (<4 hours) under POL-CAN-01, forfeiting your ₹500 slot-hold deposit (or incurring a ₹500 fee on zero-deposit bookings).
notes: Three late-arrival thresholds.

question: How much does a routine scaling and polishing cost?
golden_answer: Under the authoritative 2026 Fee Schedule (DENT-019), a routine full-mouth ultrasonic scaling and polishing (SRV-003) costs ₹1,800 (GST-exempt under SAC 9993).
notes: Authoritative 2026 tariff. Must not quote DENT-020 (2025).

question: Do I need to pay a deposit to book a wisdom tooth extraction?
golden_answer: Yes. Under Slot-Hold Deposit Policy POL-BKG-02, booking a wisdom tooth extraction (SRV-007A) or any oral surgery/extraction slot (SRV-007) with Consultant Oral Surgeon Dr. Rohan Joshi requires a ₹500 slot-hold deposit. The ₹500 deposit is 100% adjusted against your final treatment invoice when you attend, or refunded in full if you cancel at least 24 hours in advance (POL-CAN-01).
notes: Slot-hold deposit policy POL-BKG-02.

question: How can I get a copy of my X-rays, and is there a fee?
golden_answer: You can request a copy of your X-rays (and clinical records) by emailing privacy@brightsmile.example or submitting Form FRM-REC-01 in person at reception with valid Government Photo ID. A Digital Record Pack (lossless DICOM + high-resolution JPEG radiographs and PDF records via encrypted email or portal download) is ₹0 (free of charge), whereas a Physical Printed & Film/CD Pack costs a ₹150 administrative printing fee. Both have a 48-hour turnaround SLA.
notes: Digital vs printed pack have different fees.

question: What should I do in the first hour if a permanent tooth gets knocked out?
golden_answer: A knocked-out permanent tooth is a time-critical emergency (ESC-03) with a 30–60 minute window for saving the tooth: (1) Pick up the tooth by the white crown only—never touch, scrub, or wipe the root; (2) If dirty, rinse gently for no more than 10 seconds in cold milk or sterile normal saline (never tap water, soap, or tissue); (3) If you are an alert, calm adult, gently reinsert it into the socket in the right orientation and bite softly on a clean handkerchief—otherwise store it submerged in cold pasteurized milk, sterile saline, or inside your cheek pouch (never dry or in tap water); and (4) Travel immediately to BrightSmile Dental Care during clinic hours (Mon–Sat, 09:30 AM – 08:30 PM, calling +91-20-5550-0140 en route for WLK-T1 trauma care) or go to a hospital dental emergency department if it is Sunday or after hours.
notes: ESC-03 first aid; also a red-flag escalation trigger (DENT-036 §3).

question: How early should a new patient arrive for the first visit?
golden_answer: Under New Patient Registration Policy POL-REG-01, first-time patients must arrive at the 2nd-floor reception desk at least 15 minutes prior to their scheduled appointment time (doors open at 09:15 AM for 09:30 AM slots) to complete Government Photo ID verification and the Medical & Allergy Disclosure Form (FRM-MED-01).

question: Can I pay in cash, and is there a limit?
golden_answer: Yes, you can pay in Indian Rupees (INR) cash at the reception billing desk (PAY-04) with zero surcharge, subject to a hard cap of ₹1,99,999 per treatment episode under Section 269ST of the Income Tax Act. Providing your PAN is mandatory for cash payments of ₹50,000 or above.
notes: PAY-04 cash cap and PAN rule.

question: What is SRV-005A?
golden_answer: SRV-005A is Molar Root Canal Treatment (Multi-Canal) — endodontic root canal therapy for maxillary and mandibular first, second, and third molars (typically 3 to 4+ root canals across 1 to 3 sittings of 60–75 minutes each), priced at a 2026 base tariff of ₹6,800 per tooth.
notes: Dense-only ranked EQP-005 first in manual testing; lexical should win.

question: What does package PKG-003 include?
golden_answer: Package PKG-003 (Kids Cavity Shield & Hygiene Package, priced at ₹3,600 for children aged 4 to 14 years, valid for 365 days) includes: 2 paediatric dental consultations (2× SRV-001A), 1 gentle ultrasonic cleaning (1× SRV-003), full-mouth topical fluoride varnish, and 2 molar pit-and-fissure sealants.

question: What is refund rule REF-04?
golden_answer: Refund Rule REF-04 (Custom Dental Lab Prosthetics & Clear Aligners) applies to SRV-006, SRV-006A, and SRV-008A when cancellation is requested after the digital scan or impression has been transmitted to the external dental lab: 50% of the crown fee is retained (₹2,250 for PFM crown SRV-006 or ₹4,750 for Monolithic Zirconia crown SRV-006A), or ₹25,000 is retained for Clear Aligner (SRV-008A) 3D ClinCheck and tray fabrication setup. Any remaining eligible refund is returned to the original payment source within 7 to 10 working days.

question: What does policy POL-CAN-01 say?
golden_answer: Policy POL-CAN-01 (Appointment Cancellation & No-Show Policy) sets three cancellation notice tiers: (1) ≥ 24 hours before the appointment: free cancellation (₹0 fee; 100% refund of any ₹500 slot-hold deposit within 5 business days under REF-01); (2) 4 to < 24 hours before: ₹300 late cancellation fee (₹300 deducted from a ₹500 deposit with ₹200 refunded, or ₹300 added to your next visit on zero-deposit bookings); and (3) < 4 hours before or No-Show (>25 minutes late): full ₹500 slot-hold deposit forfeited (or ₹500 fee on zero-deposit bookings). Two consecutive no-shows in 12 months trigger mandatory ₹500 advance deposits for future bookings until two consecutive visits are attended on time.
notes: POL-CAN-01 is also referenced from DENT-006, DENT-024 and others; the policy doc itself should rank first.

question: If I buy the molar root canal + zirconia crown bundle and cancel after the crown scan has gone to the lab, how much do I lose?
golden_answer: Assuming the molar RCT and both X-rays are already completed, you would lose (have deducted) ₹12,750 out of the ₹14,800 paid for Package PKG-002 (leaving ₹2,050 refundable to your original payment source within 7–10 working days), provided you cancel in writing before the 90-day package validity expires. Under REF-03 and REF-04, deductions are: ₹6,800 (full 2026 standard price of the completed Molar RCT, SRV-005A) + ₹700 (full 2026 price of 2× digital RVG X-rays, SRV-002 at ₹350 each, if completed) + ₹500 (package discontinuation admin fee under REF-03) + ₹4,750 (50% non-refundable lab fee for the Monolithic Zirconia Crown SRV-006A once the scan is sent to the lab under REF-04).
notes: REVIEW: combines REF-03 (completed services at full 2026 price + ₹500 admin fee) with REF-04 (50% crown lab fee once the scan is sent). Package PKG-002 + refund rules.

question: My 15-year-old son needs a braces adjustment. Can his grandmother bring him, and which days is the orthodontist in?
golden_answer: Yes, his grandmother can bring him for a routine follow-up braces adjustment (SRV-008), provided a biological parent or court-appointed legal guardian has already signed the Standing Written Guardian Authorization Form (FRM-PED-03) in person at the clinic naming her as an authorized adult escort (aged 18+), and she brings her valid Government Photo ID. Senior Consultant Orthodontist Dr. Meera Kulkarni is available on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays.
notes: Needs standing authorization form FRM-PED-03; roster from DENT-004.

question: Can I claim a root canal on my corporate OPD insurance, and what does it cost?
golden_answer: BrightSmile Dental Care operates on an outpatient pay-and-reimburse basis (or direct corporate OPD wallet billing via MediBuddy or Vidal Health under PAY-06 where active balance allows) and issues a free 5-Document Reimbursement Pack within 24 hours, though claim approval or reimbursement cannot be guaranteed and depends on your insurer/TPA policy terms. Under the 2026 Fee Schedule, a Root Canal Treatment costs ₹5,000 per tooth for an Anterior/Premolar tooth (SRV-005) and ₹6,800 per tooth for a Molar tooth (SRV-005A), GST-exempt.
notes: Must not promise reimbursement (DENT-036 §2). Anterior vs molar price differs.

standalone_question: Is there a cheaper take-home teeth whitening option, and how much does it cost?
golden_answer: Yes, BrightSmile Dental Care offers a Custom Take-Home Whitening Tray Kit (SRV-009A) priced at ₹4,500 + 18% GST (₹5,310 gross), compared to ₹8,500 + 18% GST (₹10,030 gross) for In-Office LED Power Teeth Whitening (SRV-009). It uses custom-moulded trays with 16% carbamide peroxide gel worn for 7 to 14 consecutive nights.

standalone_question: Does a parent or guardian need to be present for a child's dental consultation?
golden_answer: Yes. question: How much is a filling?
golden_answer: The cost of a tooth-coloured composite filling depends on how many tooth surfaces are involved, which the dentist determines after an exam and RVG X-ray: a Single-Surface Composite Filling (SRV-004) costs ₹2,000 per tooth, while a Multi-Surface / Deep Composite Restoration (SRV-004A) costs ₹2,900 per tooth (both GST-exempt under the 2026 Fee Schedule).

question: What does a crown cost?
golden_answer: The cost of a dental crown depends on the material selected: a Porcelain-Fused-to-Metal (PFM) Crown (SRV-006, 5-year lab warranty) costs ₹4,500 per tooth, while a Monolithic Zirconia Crown (SRV-006A, 10-year lab warranty) costs ₹9,500 per tooth (both GST-exempt under the 2026 Fee Schedule).

question: Which antibiotic and what dose should I take for my swollen gum?
golden_answer: I cannot recommend or prescribe any antibiotic, painkiller, or medication dosage—remote prescriptions and dosage advice are strictly prohibited without an in-clinic examination. Please consult a dentist at BrightSmile Dental Care (+91-20-5550-0140) promptly; if your gum or facial swelling is rapidly spreading, causes difficulty swallowing or breathing, or is accompanied by a fever above 101°F (ESC-01), proceed immediately to the nearest 24/7 hospital emergency room (Jupiter Hospital, Baner or Manipal Hospital, Baner) or call 112 / 108.
